title: Analytics Privilegedidentityinfo
author: ep3p
description: This query can help you to obtain which accounts in IdentityInfo table have privileged groups or roles, according to values specified in certain Watchlists. IdentityInfo table renews itself completely every ~14 days. Click "Save as function", in Parameters write in the fields: "datetime"  "query_date"     "" "timespan"  "query_period"   "14d" If you name the function "PrivilegedIdentityInfo", you can check the function with queries like the following: PrivilegedIdentityInfo PrivilegedIdentityInfo(now(), 14d) let Function = (query_date:datetime, query_period:timespan = 14d){
